column1: # What a macOS machine that exists to be measured is: a guest and a bench install alike.
# Tab-separated; the first field is the table. bench/mac-quiet-desktop.sh applies, probes and judges it.
#   setting      name domain key type value why -- a `defaults` key; `@` before the domain is a key per
#                hardware UUID (`defaults -currentHost`), which `tart clone` remints for every guest
#   expected     name process why -- judged the other way round: it must be running
#   unsettable   setting-name -- a row no script can set on this macOS
#   unstoppable  process -- SIP refuses SIGSTOP for it even as root
